identity.author: Codex
identity.profile: Background item; character profile not applicable

output_lane: Reference study and standalone Canvas demo; no production-game integration
intention: The painted lake ripples gently while its shore and scene remain fixed.

required_action.axis: Horizontal source-pixel displacement; no vertical displacement
required_action.contact: No source displacement in the lower support band or stationary border
required_action.view_changes: None; the painting camera may pan independently

fixed_elements.lower_fixed_band_y: Water has a fully fixed border on every side
fixed_elements.rooms_landmarks: Every source pixel outside the reviewed weight region is fixed; no new camera or landmark warp

entry_exit.timeline: 32 frames at 125ms in Godot/Aseprite, four-second continuous periodic motion
entry_exit.frame_mapping: PNG 00..31 to Aseprite 1..32; GIF centisecond durations alternate 120 and 130ms
entry_exit.entry: Any phase in continuous ambient playback; no still/animated appearance switch
entry_exit.reference_rest: RGB source crop at indices 0 and 16
entry_exit.exit: Periodic continuation; source deformation at t=4 equals t=0
entry_exit.origin: Top-left of the recorded master-space rectangle; no trim or pivot drift

reuse_gap.appearance: Approved v5 master and exact crop; full source SHA and crop SHA are bound in the manifest
reuse_gap.gap: No accepted object-loop frames for this crop. Earlier rejected object studies are excluded. This is a fresh ambient deformation trial, not an authored acting replacement.

method.type: Deterministic local horizontal raster resampling of the whole patch, followed by a stationary transparent guard
method.interpolation: Linear horizontal colour sampling. No generated in-betweens, crossfade or retiming of an existing performance.
method.aseprite: Four one-layer editable RGBA masters; exact reopened cel/PNG comparisons in evidence/aseprite.log
method.routing_exception: None; local object workflow with no API or paid backend

runtime_size.texture_policy: All cells <=1024; lossless import; original twelve 1024 background cards
runtime_size.viewport: 1280x720 canvas_items/expand, uniform fitting camera, desktop 16:9 and 16:10 tested

motion_tolerances.actual_displacement: Driver multiplied by the source-space weight, so it reaches zero in the stationary regions
motion_tolerances.rendered_rest_limit_reason: Measured 8-bit linear texture sampling; original 16-step crop-edge failure retained and corrected by the transparent guard
motion_tolerances.loop: Periodic mathematical field; same source at t=0 and t=4; normal adjacent sampling across the seam

limits.clock_limit: A separate active-authoring/cleanup stopwatch was not retained. Machine run outputs and filesystem times do not establish that number; no invented time or cost is supplied.

attempts.disposition: Crop-edge diagnostic failed at 1280x720; evidence/crop_edge_diagnostic.json retains the result
Guarded current candidate passes source/master and desktop pixel checks; human motion review remains pending

stop_fallback: If the local deformation stretches contours, looks stiff or misstates contact, reject this candidate and retain the approved still painting until a new bounded source-based method is agreed. Do not regenerate a new item or run a per-frame generation campaign.
